_why_not_just_discover_by_comparison: Selecting rows BY the property under test is the same defect in a new shape: revert a row to
EXACT_STRING and it silently drops out of its own guard, so the guard passes by shrinking.
The enumeration must be independent of the property being asserted. This inventory is
authored; the guard then requires COMPLETE two-way accounting against the discovered rows —
every certifying row must appear in exactly one group, so a row can neither vanish from the
schema nor be quietly dropped from the inventory.
